y7-001.title: Year 7 · Lesson 001 · Welcome to Computing | Preview

questions.label: 1 · STARTING POINT
questions.originalQuestion: A friend asks for your school password. What should you do?
questions.originalQuestionHtml: A friend asks for your school password. What should you do?
questions.originalAnswer: Keep it private and ask an adult or teacher for help if someone wants access to your account.
questions.originalAnswerHtml:
SUGGESTED ANSWER

Keep it private and ask an adult or teacher for help if someone wants access to your account.

questions.label: 2 · STARTING POINT
questions.originalQuestion: Why should drinks be kept away from computers?
questions.originalQuestionHtml: Why should drinks be kept away from computers?
questions.originalAnswer: Spills could damage the equipment or make it unsafe.
questions.originalAnswerHtml:
SUGGESTED ANSWER

Spills could damage the equipment or make it unsafe.

questions.label: 3 · STARTING POINT
questions.originalQuestion: What would you do if you saw something worrying online?
questions.originalQuestionHtml: What would you do if you saw something worrying online?
questions.originalAnswer: Stop interacting with it and tell a trusted adult or teacher.
questions.originalAnswerHtml:
SUGGESTED ANSWER

Stop interacting with it and tell a trusted adult or teacher.

questions.label: 4 · CHALLENGE
questions.originalQuestion: Challenge: How could you show that a piece of digital work is your own?
questions.originalQuestionHtml: Challenge: How could you show that a piece of digital work is your own?
questions.originalAnswer: Save it in your own account with a clear title and, if your teacher asks, provide a safe screenshot that shows the work but not passwords or personal information.
questions.originalAnswerHtml:
SUGGESTED ANSWER

Save it in your own account with a clear title and, if your teacher asks, provide a safe screenshot that shows the work but not passwords or personal information.

questions.label: 1 · RETRIEVAL
questions.originalQuestion: Can school email be used for personal messages?
questions.originalQuestionHtml: Can school email be used for personal messages?
questions.originalAnswer: No. School email should be used for school purposes.
questions.originalAnswerHtml:
ANSWER

No. School email should be used for school purposes.

questions.label: 2 · RETRIEVAL
questions.originalQuestion: Name the four main parts of a formal email.
questions.originalQuestionHtml: Name the four main parts of a formal email.
questions.originalAnswerHtml:
ANSWER

Subject, greeting, body and sign-off.

questions.label: 3 · RETRIEVAL
questions.originalQuestion: Give two ways to make a strong school password.
questions.originalQuestionHtml: Give two ways to make a strong school password.
questions.originalAnswer: Use a sufficiently long password that is hard to guess and avoid obvious personal information. Follow school password requirements.
questions.originalAnswerHtml:
ANSWER

Use a sufficiently long password that is hard to guess and avoid obvious personal information. Follow school password requirements.

questions.label: 4 · CHALLENGE
questions.originalQuestion: Why might someone use Bcc when emailing several families?
questions.originalQuestionHtml: Why might someone use Bcc when emailing several families?
questions.originalAnswer: Bcc prevents recipients seeing one another’s email addresses, protecting privacy.
questions.originalAnswerHtml:
ANSWER

Bcc prevents recipients seeing one another’s email addresses, protecting privacy.

y7-004.title: Year 7 · Lesson 004 · OneDrive & Class Notebook | Preview

questions.originalQuestion: True or false: after completing a Teams assignment, you should choose Hand In.
questions.originalQuestionHtml: True or false: after completing a Teams assignment, you should choose Hand In.
questions.originalAnswer: True. Hand In submits your completed Teams assignment; saving or closing it is not the same as submitting.
questions.originalAnswerHtml:

True. Hand In submits your completed Teams assignment; saving or closing it is not the same as submitting.

questions.originalQuestionHtml: Which Microsoft app is used to create and use Class Notebook: Notion, OneNote, Evernote or Google Docs?
questions.originalAnswer: Microsoft OneNote. Class Notebook is a notebook used in Microsoft Teams / OneNote.

Microsoft OneNote. Class Notebook is a notebook used in Microsoft Teams / OneNote.

Posts, Files, Class Notebook and Assignments. The four areas help you find communication, files, learning and tasks.

questions.label: 4 · CHALLENGE
questions.originalQuestion: Challenge: in an email, what is the difference between To, Cc and Bcc?
questions.originalQuestionHtml: Challenge: in an email, what is the difference between To, Cc and Bcc?
questions.originalAnswer: To: the main recipient(s) who should act. Cc: copies for people kept informed. Bcc: hides recipient addresses from other recipients.
questions.originalAnswerHtml:
ANSWER

To: the main recipient(s) who should act. Cc: copies for people kept informed. Bcc: hides recipient addresses from other recipients.
